## v0.7.0 — Voice recorder (microSD WAV)

Adds an on-device **Recorder** app: MEMS mic → microSD WAV, with a global G0 hotkey.

**Apps:** Torch → Timer → Stopwatch → **Recorder** → Web → SSH → Settings

---

### Recorder

- 16 kHz mono 16-bit PCM WAV under `/rec/REC_XXXX.wav` (requires formatted microSD)
- List / record / play / delete (confirm)
- Max length **10 min**; Del while recording discards; Enter / G0 stop saves
- List shows stem names (no `.wav`); `+ New recording` row
- Play: `Del` → delete confirm; `Enter` no-op; `←` back to list

### G0 (BtnA)

- **Short** (any app) → open Recorder and start recording; while recording → stop & save
- **Long** (~0.5 s) → M5Launcher (factory), as before

### Other

- Shared `SdFs` helper for Adv microSD SPI (CS=12)
- Desktop sim stubs Mic / Speaker / SD (Recorder shows unavailable)
- Release assets remain versioned: `cardputer_adv_firmware-0.7.0.bin`, `CardputerCompanion-0.7.0.apk`

Companion unchanged: `0.6.2-m3` (bundled APK still attached by CI).
